    Documentation/ HEPkit

    UfoLoader

    class UfoLoader

    Load and normalize a Universal FeynRules Output model.

    The loader delegates UFO parsing to ufo_model_loader and returns typed HEP model entities suitable for process and diagram generation.

    Examples

    Replace path/to/MyUFO with the directory containing your UFO model (particles.py, vertices.py, and related files).

    from symbolica.community import hepkit as hep
loader = hep.UfoLoader()
loaded = loader.load("path/to/MyUFO")

    Parameters

    • restriction_name (str, optional) Restriction-card name to apply while loading.
    • simplify_model (bool, optional) Simplify normalized symbolic model expressions.
    • wrap_indices_in_lorentz_structures (bool, optional) Wrap normalized indices in Lorentz structures.

    Attributes

    Name Description
    restriction_name Return the configured restriction-card name.
    simplify_model Return whether model simplification is enabled.
    wrap_indices_in_lorentz_structures Return whether normalized Lorentz indices are wrapped.

    restriction_name

    UfoLoader.restriction_name: typing.Optional[builtins.str]

    Return the configured restriction-card name.

    Examples

    Using the setup in the UfoLoader class example:

    loader = hep.UfoLoader(restriction_name="massless")
assert loader.restriction_name == "massless"

    simplify_model

    UfoLoader.simplify_model: builtins.bool

    Return whether model simplification is enabled.

    Examples

    Using the setup in the UfoLoader class example:

    loader = hep.UfoLoader(simplify_model=False)
assert not loader.simplify_model

    wrap_indices_in_lorentz_structures

    UfoLoader.wrap_indices_in_lorentz_structures: builtins.bool

    Return whether normalized Lorentz indices are wrapped.

    Examples

    Using the setup in the UfoLoader class example:

    loader = hep.UfoLoader(wrap_indices_in_lorentz_structures=True)
assert loader.wrap_indices_in_lorentz_structures
